background: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Wells Fargo, one of the four largest US banks, with the largest branch network in the country, serving consumers, small businesses and corporates across the United States.
synthesis: Wells Fargo Bank is rated AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, all three on a stable outlook, with no rating action since a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 7 Feb 2018. Leverage of 8.0% is in the top quarter of US banks, while CET1 of 12.1% sits at the peer median after falling 1.2 points since 30 Jun 2025, the one ratio moving the wrong way. LCR of 119% is level with the peer median and broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 17 Sep 2026, is further layoffs at one campus, a cost measure rather than a credit event.
